Gadriel Code — static application security testing

Usage: gadriel [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  auth        License-token management (ADR-088 §6.6)
  config      View/set configuration
  doctor      Diagnose issues and verify configuration
  version     Show version
  completion  Generate shell completions
  update      Self-update
  init        Initialize code-security in this repo (the W1 consolidated scaffold — `.security/`, `.claude/`, git hooks, MCP server, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore)
  install     (DEPRECATED) Use `gadriel init --skip-claude` instead
  watch       File-save async validator (Layer 1) — L1-lite watcher (BUG-022, Wave K / 2026-05-16): Secrets+SAST per-file scans on save, 300ms debounced, merges into `.security/findings.json`
  scan        Run a code-security scan (Layers 2/3/4 via flags)
  fix         Triage a finding by ID — confirm real, dismiss as a false positive, or hand it to an AI agent for remediation
  findings    Read findings from .security/findings.json
  sbom        Export SBOM (SPDX 2.3 + CycloneDX 1.4) per ADR-084
  cbom        Emit a CycloneDX CBOM (cryptographic-asset inventory: keys, certificates, algorithms, protocols) per **ADR-241**
  report      Generate per-framework compliance reports (Markdown by default, optional typst PDF source) per ADR-085 §5, **or** emit the new RVF World-Class static HTML / JSON report bundle (Wave 5)
  dashboard   [DEPRECATED — use `report`] Open the local web dashboard (ADR-089), bound to `127.0.0.1`. Superseded by the static HTML report per ADR-137 §5 item 2; kept functional pending removal
  policies    Manage GVL rule corpus + advisory snapshots
  store       RVF substrate operations — list, verify, rebuild, migrate the `.rvf` files under per-machine + per-repo store roots
  compare     Compare two recorded runs of this repo
  verdict     Readiness go/no-go verdict — the single aggregated **go / no-go / go-with-conditions** answer (ADR-067-9 / W3.2)
  learn       Inspect the learning flywheel — learned priors, calibration-table version, federation opt-in state (ADR-140 §2.8)
  skills      Scan and govern the agentic skills installed in this workspace.
  mcp         Start the MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio) per ADR-087 D1+D7
  telemetry   Telemetry preferences (ADR-140 §2.5 — opt-in, privacy-gated)
  hooks       Claude Code hook dispatcher — invoked by the `.claude/helpers/gadriel-hook.sh` shim. Each subcommand maps to one event in `.claude/settings.json`. The dispatcher always exits 0 so a misbehaving hook never blocks a Claude turn
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json             Output as JSON (overrides --format)
  -q, --quiet            Minimal output for CI
  -v, --verbose          Verbose output
      --no-color         Disable colored output
      --portal <PORTAL>  Override portal URL
      --config <CONFIG>  Use specific config file
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version

QUICK START:
  gadriel scan .                        Scan this repository
  gadriel findings                      Read the findings from the last scan
  gadriel init                          Scaffold .security/ and editor integration

WHICH COMMAND SHOULD I USE?
  scan       - Analyse source code. SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, containers, APIs
               and agentic skills, over a path you give it.
               Example: gadriel scan . --fail-on high

  findings   - Read what the last scan produced, without rescanning.
               Example: gadriel findings --format json

  fix        - Triage one finding: confirm it, dismiss it as a false positive,
               or hand it to an AI agent to remediate.
               Example: gadriel fix CODE-W1-L1-008

  watch      - Re-scan a file as you save it, for editor feedback.

  report     - Per-framework compliance reports, or the static HTML bundle.

  sbom       - Export SPDX 2.3 + CycloneDX 1.4.

  verdict    - The aggregated go / no-go readiness answer.

TESTING A RUNNING AGENT?
  That is the other product. Install `gbehavior
